message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 74.4% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in IOT and cloud computing. I want to become a Quality Assurance Associate. My family can afford at most about USD 5600 per year. I live in Kolkata. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: interested in IOT and cloud computing

explanation:
This program is located in Kolkata, meeting your strong preference to stay near home. It focuses on Computer Science and Cloud/Networking, aligning well with your background and interests while offering a manageable tuition fee.

Located in Pune, this MTech program covers networking and cloud computing, which matches your stated interests. It has a high placement rate (83%) and a strong median starting salary ($15192), prioritizing job outcomes.

This MSc Cloud Computing program is in Coimbatore, offering relevant coursework (networking/cloud) and a good median starting salary ($13015). Its tuition fee is also within your family's budget.

This MTech program in Chennai focuses on networking and cloud computing. It has a high placement rate (85%) and is located in India, making it a strong contender for career growth.

While focused on Cyber Security, this program is highly affordable ($1150 tuition) and located in Chennai. It meets the criteria of being near home (if you consider South India) and has a low entry grade requirement.
